subject.title: feat(tui): opt-in persistence and agent visibility for `!`/`!!` local shell commands

question: Should OpenClaw permanently allow explicitly approved TUI-local shell output to be stored in session history and optionally exposed to the agent through an operator-admin gateway contract?
rationale: Tests can establish mechanics, but maintainers must authorize the durable sensitive-data boundary, the `!`/`!!` user convention, and the long-term protocol surface.

options.title: Approve exact-session opt-in
options.body: Adopt the capability with local-only as default after consent is keyed to full agent-session identity, defects are repaired, and real-path proof is complete.

options.title: Keep shell output local
options.body: Retain current local command execution without transcript persistence or model visibility.

options.title: Redesign the sharing action
options.body: Allow sharing only through a separate explicit interaction or generic transcript action rather than assigning new semantics to `!` and `!!`.

recommendation.title: Approve exact-session opt-in
recommendation.body: Adopt the capability with local-only as default after consent is keyed to full agent-session identity, defects are repaired, and real-path proof is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Their relevant history covers the affected TUI, transcript, gateway, and protocol boundaries.
